purpose: Researched reference catalogue for the store implementation. These are supplier reference prices, not GearLane sale offers or live inventory.
method: Publicly accessible primary supplier product pages and supplier collection/category listings were consulted on the research date. Product names, displayed MYR amounts and limited explicitly stated specifications were recorded. Generic GL SKUs are internal catalogue identifiers, not manufacturer part numbers. The observation date records research retrieval, not a claim that search caches were refreshed that day.
launchRequirements: Every record starts stock 0 and priceConfirmed false. Keep checkout blocked until staff confirm actual shop inventory and selling price. Database seeding must map priceConfirmed to price_confirmed.
Confirm brand, exact variant/package, authenticity, vehicle engine/chassis/year, seller price, tax and delivery before enabling sales.
Fitment names are supplier-stated applications only, not verified compatibility. Do not use category names or supplierApplication as automatic vehicle-fitment guarantees.
Do not copy supplier images without permission. All imageUrl values are null; add store-owned or licensed photographs.

Manufacturer technical approvals, official oil performance certifications, authenticity and material claims were not independently established. The verified evidence is the named supplier's listing, not laboratory or manufacturer validation.
No supplier stock claims were imported. Supplier availability, sold counts and discounts are excluded.
Descriptions are short original factual summaries. Do not present warranty, performance, maintenance intervals or safety claims not specifically verified.

sources.scope: 42 directly retrieved product detail pages. Product-level URLs are included in each catalogue record.
sources.limitations: Several listings allow equivalent brands/part numbers. Catalogue preserves unknown brands and alternative brands instead of asserting exact stock. Brand labels reflect supplier listings and are not authenticity certification.

sources.scope: 8 fixed-price TRW front brake pad listings. Direct linked product URLs captured from this category.
sources.limitations: Linked brake-pad detail fetches returned cache misses. Each record supplies priceSourceUrl and priceNote. Only clearly displayed product name, part number, position and price are used.

sources.scope: 3 named downpipes, exact fixed MYR prices and direct product links from the supplier collection.
sources.limitations: Linked detail pages returned cache misses; no material, diameter, installation, road legality or power claims are inferred.

sources.scope: 2 Liqui Moly brake fluids verified using main product page prices.
sources.limitations: Product pages and related/category cards have conflicting cached amounts. Main product prices were selected and the discrepancy is explicitly recorded.

sources.scope: Bosch AP32 single pack, RM115.57 from supplier product detail search result; matching category listing also shows the same amount.
sources.limitations: The product text contains an AP18 copy error; AP32 is supported by title and SKU. Shipping dimensions do not establish blade length. The product is not for U-hook arms.

qualityIssues.issue: Product URL says 4 litres but displayed product heading and specification state 3.5 litres. Catalogue uses 3.5 L; staff must verify packaging.
Supplier title incorrectly calls Axia a Proton. Catalogue avoids this title claim, uses NGK LKR6C only, and preserves 'or equivalent' in supplierPartNumber. Pack quantity was not assumed.
Supplier title/URL have inconsistent or incomplete oil-brand/volume information. Catalogue omits brand and volume and requires staff review.
Same page states D6806 and D6804 in different sections. Catalogue omits the conflicting part number, flags review and retains only named applications/set size.
DOT 4 main product page RM65.00; related-product card elsewhere RM50.00. Reference price selected is RM65.00; no assumed sale price.
DOT 5.1 EV main product page RM118.00; category listing RM135.00. Reference price selected is RM118.00; no assumed discount.
AP32 title and SKU versus AP18 in descriptive copy. No blade length or multi-arm universal-fit claim imported.
Collection prices RM149.90 but product pages expose front/rear/type variants without clearly mapped prices. Omitted instead of attributing a price to an unverified variant.
